description: D42 backlog: vendor the Lora face at uiscale/fonts/Lora-Variable.ttf (copy of empire-remastered ui_scale_mod/font_src/Lora-Variable.ttf, same sha256; SIL OFL text already in uiscale/fonts/OFL.txt). title: Vendor the Lora font face for the UI scale fonts
